name: GEANT
capacity_unit: Values in the FIGRET file (10e9, 2.4e9, 155e6). FIGRET's normalize_size divides capacities and demands by 1e9 at load time. This collection stores the published numbers unscaled.
rejected_alternative: Topology Zoo Geant / Geant2001 / Geant2009 / Geant2010 / Geant2011 / Geant2012 are a different network family. They are kept under data/raw/topology_zoo and are not copied into processed topologies.
